metaData.title: Anomaly Detection Engine — Configurable Thresholds (F-M5-02)
referenceBasis: FRD Maritime Border Intelligence System §3.5.1 Jenis Anomali (AN-01..AN-10)
FRD F-M5-02 Configurable Thresholds — Administrator dapat mengkonfigurasi parameter deteksi (waktu, jarak, frekuensi) tanpa modifikasi kode
Global Fishing Watch — AIS gaps flagged >24h; port-stop gaps use 4h+; going-dark analysis
Global Fishing Watch — vessels not moving faster than 3 knots transmit at anchored/moored interval (loitering speed floor)
Maritime deviation analysis — ports under 100 NM of a main route considered low deviation; vessel-risk systems use ~10 km deviation upper limit
STS transfer / rendezvous detection — proximity buffers commonly 100 m to 500 m held for a threshold dwell time
Cluster / multi-entity activity — configurable minimum concurrent entity count in a geo-temporal window

data.note: Defaults align with FRD AN-01..AN-10. Each parameter governs one or more anomaly rule codes. An anomaly is 'detected' (active) while its measured metric >= the configured threshold; raising a threshold suppresses instances that no longer exceed it.

parameters.label: AIS-Off Gap
parameters.description: Minimum continuous AIS signal loss before a vessel is flagged as dark.
parameters.reference: FRD AN-01 default 6h. Global Fishing Watch flags AIS gaps >24h and treats 4h+ gaps as port stops.

parameters.label: Loitering Dwell
parameters.description: Minimum time a vessel moves below the loitering speed floor (<3 kn) in one area before it is flagged.
parameters.reference: FRD AN-02 (<2 kn sustained). GFW: vessels not exceeding ~3 kn are treated as anchored/moored, the loitering speed floor.

parameters.label: Route Deviation
parameters.description: Maximum lateral distance from the registered corridor / flight plan before a deviation alert fires.
parameters.reference: FRD AN-04 (X NM from standard lane). Maritime-deviation research: <100 NM low deviation; vessel-risk systems use ~10 km (≈5.4 NM) upper limit.

parameters.label: Restricted-Zone Dwell
parameters.description: Minimum time an unauthorised entity stays inside a restricted/disputed zone before it is flagged.
parameters.reference: FRD AN-05 (entry without clearance). A dwell floor filters brief transits from sustained unauthorised presence.

parameters.label: Cluster Size
parameters.description: Minimum number of concurrent entities in one geo-temporal window before a cluster is flagged.
parameters.reference: FRD AN-10 (significant multi-entity increase in a small area/time). Configurable concurrent-entity count per rendezvous/cluster analysis.
